fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: the brand and button at the left, the columns at the right, over the background. Variant B: one row (brand, button, columns; the social squares without their title) on a black-to-teal gradient (no background media).

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark (white, on transparent).

fields.name: logoAlt
fields.label: Logo alt text
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors.

fields.name: logoLink
fields.label: Logo link
fields.description: Where the logo leads, e.g. the home page.

fields.name: copyright
fields.label: Copyright
fields.description: E.g. © 2026 JSW Motors.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: E.g. Mumbai, India.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: The white button's text, e.g. REGISTER INTEREST (a + follows it). Leave empty for no button.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Where the button leads: a page, a URL or a mailto: address. Without a link the button is not shown.

fields.name: legalLink
fields.label: Legal link
fields.description: E.g. the privacy policy.

fields.name: legalLinkText
fields.label: Legal link label
fields.description: E.g. PRIVACY POLICY.

fields.name: backgroundMedia
fields.label: Background media
fields.description: Variant A's background: the image, or the video (playing muted, looping; the image is its poster and stays for visitors who prefer less motion). Not used by Variant B.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Fills the footer behind everything (dark at the top, where the texts sit). With a video: its poster.

fields.name: backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: An MP4 (or WebM) video asset, used when the Background media is Video.

fields.name: socialHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: The social icons' heading, e.g. CONNECT (in Variant B read out by screen readers only). The icons are the footer's Social Link children (up to 4 are shown).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: E.g. TECHNOLOGY.

fields.name: link1
fields.label: Link 1
fields.description: A page, a URL or a mailto: address. A column has up to 4 links (Link 1 to Link 4); leave a link empty to not show it.

fields.name: link1Text
fields.label: Link 1 text
fields.description: E.g. NEVs.

fields.name: link2
fields.label: Link 2
fields.description: A page, a URL or a mailto: address. Leave empty to not show it.

fields.name: link3
fields.label: Link 3
fields.description: A page, a URL or a mailto: address. Leave empty to not show it.

fields.name: link4
fields.label: Link 4
fields.description: A page, a URL or a mailto: address. Leave empty to not show it.

fields.name: network
fields.label: Network
fields.description: Its icon (a square button), and the link's name for screen readers.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Profile link
fields.description: The network's page, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/…

fields.name: label
fields.label: Accessible name
fields.description: Optional: what screen readers announce, e.g. JSW Motors on LinkedIn (default: JSW Motors on <network>).
